Indexed native scan coverage is published on formalize at 81d14cff3e7e9067cc20882b22aafccf52538e38 (four commits). NativeBranchCompletion.complete_with_history_resources_accepting constructs the actual completed receipt at the chosen processed index from original accepted-edge semantics and projection support for the earlier selected prefix. It retains original resource bounds, actual input/branch callers, full Memos, Posts, cache restore, old-variable agreement and a satisfying filling in the chosen branch's own resulting state. Later alternatives may stop; that branch endpoint need not equal the aggregate final endpoint. parent_complete_resources derives the edge/index from the stored parent model and actual selector permutation, with explicit ALL-selected projection support, and returns a completed aggregate scan plus the chosen receipt. Context alone does not derive that support.

Three new modules, 720 lines, three public theorems. Strict checks and Audit pass: 4248 jobs, 80083 theorem dependencies. Public readback has 176 complete blocks; all 173 old blocks are an exact prefix. Only the standard three axioms occur. Preserved: 93 prior strong modules, 440 Enumeration sources, 203 Haskell sources, all nine old document bodies, failed and successful attempts. Three reviews are sealed. Portable and committed verification pass: 535 payloads, 125 gzip archives, 137 source records. Manifest SHA256 cc6557e3e6ec07aed5ae93f70bc850edb872652c287a043e6cca5135b94140f2. Evidence: lean/restart-evidence/20261027-native-scan-coverage/; restart note: lean/notes-current-native-scan-coverage.md.

Next: actual NativeContinuations/finite sibling induction with the post-hook caller and full Memos, retaining precise earlier hook stops. Current NativeBranches coverage does not prove whole recursive coverage. H6 finite pruning language preservation and conditional rendered soundness retain their scopes; API admission and physical Haskell correspondence remain open. No Haskell change, native test or benchmark. LPO fixes remain integrated; KBO context-reversal handoff remains open in FINDINGS. Goal ACTIVE.
